exact_adapter_test.required_forward: every exact integral genus-one MB104 carrier C in |lD_1| gives a nonzero homogeneous incidence class
exact_adapter_test.required_reverse: every nonzero homogeneous class counted by the H2 Hilbert/regularity object represents an exact carrier with integrality, genus one, balanced packet and passport

natural_submodule_case.premise: carrier section s_C is retained inside an R-stable graded submodule/ideal
natural_submodule_case.failure: 2C is nonreduced and nonintegral, so exact reverse adapter fails

alternatives: let positive-degree section multiplication act geometrically: then products add divisor components and destroy exact integrality/genus/packet/passport
force those products to zero or quotient them away: then carrier classes become artificial R-torsion and finite generation/finite length is no longer implied by the exact incidence geometry
take a degreewise direct sum of incidence coordinate spaces: there is no source-complete multiplication preserving the exact carrier condition, so regularity of R does not give a finite-degree cutoff
auxiliary_module_case.conclusion: No exact noncircular F/R bridge from carriers to a finite-generation/regularity module is presently available.

degree_dependent_packet.consequence: the exact packet/passport is degree-dependent and is not preserved by ordinary section multiplication

decision.strongest_safe_claim: H2's proposed exact graded-module/regularity adapter is invalid as stated; fixed-degree scheme-theoretic incidence remains possible but does not reduce all l to finitely many degrees.
decision.missing_lemma: A materially new theorem giving degree-compatible multiplication or bounded generation for the exact integral genus-one packet incidence, without replacing exact carrier semantics by a larger multiplicatively closed locus.
